title: Awscli@1: pyasn1 has quadratic-time denial of service in constructed string and indefinite-length ANY decoding…
description: CVE-2026-119195 is a denial-of-service vulnerability in pyasn1 versions 0.6.4 and earlier, affecting awscli@1 versions >=1.20.20. The flaw causes quadratic-time CPU consumption when decoding constructed OCTET STRINGs or indefinite-length ANY types composed of many fragments, leading to CPU exhaustion. This occurs because the decoder repeatedly concatenates fragments inefficiently, causing excessive CPU use proportional to the square of the number of fragments. The vulnerability impacts BER and CER decoding paths and certain non-conforming DER inputs. No confidentiality or integrity impact is reported.
